en.title: Skidding Bruins hit Detroit on a back-to-back as Tarasov stays hot
en.deck: Boston has lost three straight for the first time this season, scoring four goals in those games, and plays the second half of a back-to-back. Detroit snapped a five-game slide behind a Daniil Tarasov shutout in Tampa and is still without Dylan Larkin. The market has Detroit as a slight favourite, and the model leans a bit further that way.
news: The Bruins were shut out 3-0 by the Kings at home on Tuesday with Michael DiPietro in goal. They have trailed first in three straight games and have been outscored 14-4 in the skid.
Jeremy Swayman (.906, 2.60 GAA) is the likely Boston starter after DiPietro played Tuesday. Rookie James Hagens is out with a back injury.

Detroit suspended Dylan Larkin without pay on Oct. 29 after he said he would no longer play for the team; he stays out until a trade. Defenceman Simon Edvinsson is still unsigned and must sign by Dec. 1 to play this season.
Tarasov made 31 saves in a 2-0 win at Tampa on Saturday, his second shutout in nine appearances for Detroit. He has a .931 save percentage, while John Gibson has lost his last four starts.
records: Detroit's win in Tampa ended the Lightning's 8-0 home start and Detroit's own five-game losing streak.
The Red Wings rank 27th in goals per game and have scored 1.8 a game over their last five.
David Pastrnak leads Boston with 26 points (9 goals, 17 assists) in 21 games.
Charlie McAvoy is two assists from 300 in his career but has gone 14 games without a goal.
betting: Market: Red Wings 1.83, Bruins 2.02, about 52–48 without the margin. The model has Detroit at 56%, a little warmer on the home side than the price, partly because Boston is on a back-to-back.
Total: over 5.5 at 1.65 is about 57% after the margin. The model says 56%, so they agree. The last six meetings averaged 5.2 goals, a touch under the line.

sv.title: Bruins i svacka möter Detroit dagen efter – och Tarasov är het
sv.deck: Boston har förlorat tre raka för första gången den här säsongen, med bara fyra gjorda mål, och spelar andra matchen på två dagar. Detroit bröt en svit på fem förluster tack vare en hållning av Daniil Tarasov i Tampa och saknar fortfarande Dylan Larkin. Marknaden har Detroit som knapp favorit, och modellen lutar lite mer åt samma håll.
news: Bruins föll med 0–3 hemma mot Kings i tisdags med Michael DiPietro i mål. De har släppt in första målet tre matcher i rad och förlorat med sammanlagt 4–14 under svackan.
Jeremy Swayman (,906, 2,60 insläppta per match) väntas stå för Boston eftersom DiPietro spelade i tisdags. Rookien James Hagens är borta med en ryggskada.

Detroit stängde av Dylan Larkin utan lön den 29 oktober efter att han sagt att han inte längre tänker spela för klubben. Han står utanför tills han tradas. Backen Simon Edvinsson saknar fortfarande kontrakt och måste skriva på senast 1 december för att få spela i år.

Tarasov gjorde 31 räddningar när Detroit vann med 2–0 i Tampa i lördags, hans andra hållning på nio matcher i klubben. Han har en räddningsprocent på ,931, medan John Gibson har förlorat sina fyra senaste starter.
records: Segern i Tampa bröt Lightnings 8–0-inledning hemma och Detroits egen förlustsvit på fem matcher.
Red Wings ligger 27:a i ligan i gjorda mål per match och har gjort 1,8 mål per match de senaste fem.
David Pastrnak leder Boston med 26 poäng (9 mål, 17 assist) på 21 matcher.
Charlie McAvoy har två assist kvar till 300 i karriären men har gått 14 matcher utan mål.

en.title: Hellebuyck's unbeaten Devils chase an eighth straight home win
en.deck: New Jersey is 13-3-0 since a 2-3 start, has won seven in a row at home and is 7-0-0 with Connor Hellebuyck in net. Montreal saw a 12-game point streak end and has scored once in each of its last two games, with key players hurt. The market makes the Devils clear favourites; the model is a little less sure.
news: Hellebuyck, acquired from Winnipeg on Oct. 23, is 7-0-0 with a 2.25 GAA for New Jersey. He made 41 saves in a 7-4 win in Washington on Saturday.
Rookie Jacob Fowler (9-2-2) is expected in goal for Montreal. He has allowed 18 goals over his last six starts.
Canadiens: alternate captains Josh Anderson (three to four weeks) and Mike Matheson (two to three weeks) are out, joining Chris Kreider, Ivan Demidov and Sam Montembeault on injured reserve.
Devils: Anthony Mantha (about a month after surgery) and Johnathan Kovacevic (four to six weeks) are out. Brett Pesce is back after an illness.
records: The Devils have outscored opponents 32-15 during their seven-game home winning streak.
Jesper Bratt has an eight-game point streak (2 goals, 8 assists) and 23 points in 23 career games against Montreal.
Montreal's power play is 0-for-12 over four games and second-to-last in the league at 12.5%.
New Jersey is 6-0-1 against Montreal since its last regulation loss to the Canadiens in January 2024.

sv.title: Obesegrade Hellebuyck och Devils jagar åttonde raka hemmasegern
sv.deck: New Jersey har gått 13-3-0 sedan inledningen på 2-3, vunnit sju raka hemma och är 7-0-0 med Connor Hellebuyck i mål. Montreal såg en poängsvit på 12 matcher ta slut och har bara gjort ett mål i var och en av de två senaste matcherna, med flera nyckelspelare skadade. Marknaden gör Devils till klar favorit; modellen är lite mindre säker.
news: Hellebuyck, som kom från Winnipeg den 23 oktober, är 7-0-0 med 2,25 insläppta mål per match för New Jersey. Han gjorde 41 räddningar när Devils vann med 7–4 i Washington i lördags.

en.title: Avalanche without MacKinnon and Makar meet a Mammoth team on a six-game skid
en.deck: Colorado plays its second game without Nathan MacKinnon and Cale Makar, both hurt against Ottawa last week. Utah has lost six straight (0-3-3) and goalie Karel Vejmelka is struggling. It is their first meeting this season, with the Winter Classic in Salt Lake City still to come, and both the market and the model see a coin flip.
news: MacKinnon is out about a month and Makar about two weeks with lower-body injuries. Josh Manson (ankle) is also out, and Colorado claimed defenceman Mike Reilly off waivers.
Mackenzie Blackwood is 7-1-1 over his last nine starts. Scott Wedgewood left practice on Sunday with an illness.
Utah's Vejmelka is 1-6-2 with an .853 save percentage over his last nine starts. John Marino, Nate Schmidt, Dylan Guenther and Nick Schmaltz are out.
Logan Cooley returned on Monday after missing three games. He scored 10 goals in seven games from Oct. 22 to Nov. 5, with two hat tricks.
records: Utah started 10-6-0 and is now 10-9-3; it lost 3-2 to last-place Vancouver on Monday.
Vincent Trocheck is one assist from 400 in his career, and Clayton Keller is three away.
Utah's power play is third in the league at 33.8%, but its penalty kill is 28th at 69.3%.
Artturi Lehkonen leads Colorado with 15 goals and has scored in three straight games; the teams meet again outdoors at Rice-Eccles Stadium on Dec. 31.
betting: Market: Mammoth 1.87, Avalanche 1.97, about 51–49 without the margin. The model has it 50–50, a hair warmer on Colorado.
Total: over 5.5 at 1.60 is about 59%. The model says 57%, close to the market, though the last six meetings averaged only 4.5 goals.

sv.title: Avalanche utan MacKinnon och Makar möter Mammoth mitt i en förlustsvit
sv.deck: Colorado spelar sin andra match utan Nathan MacKinnon och Cale Makar, som båda skadades mot Ottawa förra veckan. Utah har förlorat sex raka (0-3-3) och målvakten Karel Vejmelka går tungt. Det är säsongens första möte, med Winter Classic i Salt Lake City längre fram, och både marknaden och modellen ser en slantsingling.
